Did your mum or grandma ever cook chicken this way? I love how just a few ingredients can produce the most beautiful golden chicken essence. And when a recipe is this simple, the quality of the chicken really matters. I used @Kee Song Food Sakura Chicken, raised with No Antibiotics Ever and fed with Lactobacillus. Available at @FairPrice SG  Steamed Chicken with Liquid Gold Essence Ingredients: • 3 Sakura Chicken Whole Leg • 3 slices ginger • 3 red dates  • A handful of goji berries Method: Place a small heatproof bowl upside down on a steaming plate. Arrange chicken and ingredients around the bowl. Steam for about 35 minutes, or until fully cooked. Sakura bone in legs: AZY-RNH-JFJ #octshopeefinds
